headline: Approved survey questions on the noise ordinance and city website, plus the 2027 ward meeting schedule.
summary: Traffic safety, trees, and residents' safety from ICE came up at the Ward 5 meeting. Ideas for the future included childcare at ward meetings and student help reviewing the city website. The committee also approved the City Council newsletter for this month.
decisions: Approved the City Council newsletter for this month and kept it in committee.
Approved the neighborhood ward meeting schedule, five in favor.
Approved survey questions on the noise ordinance, five in favor and none against, pending final edits.
Approved city website survey questions, five in favor and zero against, pending final edits.
discussion: Childcare at ward meetings: Organizing childcare looked tricky, because of background checks, volunteer sign-ups, and safety rules. A neighboring community's recreation program brings games and crafts to its meetings, and an idea was raised to look into the same.

Noise survey questions: The group weighed narrower time blocks and an option for people who did not know how to report a noise problem. It also suggested asking city departments for past complaint records.
Route 93 noise: A resident said noise from Route 93 has affected families on its east side since 1960 and asked for a sound barrier there, as the west side has.
City website improvements: Ideas included pulling site usage statistics from the IT department and having vocational school students review the site.
